description: Sign-in, MFA, PAM and identity governance for about 45,000 workforce users and partner accounts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Every division system federates to SYS-G1; without sign-in no planner, gate clerk, trader or property manager can work, and OT engineers cannot reach the T5 equipment control system
manual_workaround: Sealed break-glass accounts per critical system, held by each terminal FSO; cached credentials on gate booth workstations for one shift
dependent_third_parties: Identity SaaS vendor
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Used by every process below

business_process: Cloud landing zones, WAN and site connectivity
description: Network hubs, guardrails, keys and logging in providers A and B; WAN links to 9 terminals, 38 yards, 46 warehouses and offices
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: SYS-T1 and SYS-T6 run in provider A; terminals T1 to T6 cannot reach the TOS without the WAN and the hub; the T5 automated stacking cranes stop when the TOS link is lost
manual_workaround: Cellular failover at every terminal gate complex; terminals fall back to local mode (cranes) and manual gate
dependent_third_parties: Cloud providers A and B; carriers
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Marine Terminals T1 to T6; Freight Trading SaaS access; Port Real Estate SaaS access

description: 24x7 SOC, SIEM, EDR and incident handling for all divisions
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Coast Guard reporting under 33 CFR 6.16-1 is due immediately and DFARS 252.204-7012 reports within 72 hours; Form 8-K Item 1.05 runs 4 business days after a materiality determination; all depend on SOC facts
manual_workaround: Forensic retainer firm's tooling; EDR console reachable from provider B
dependent_third_parties: SIEM and EDR vendors; forensic retainer firms (insurance panel)
dependent_people_or_facilities: SOC analysts; division liaisons; Division CySO
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: All divisions depend on the SOC for detection and incident facts; Gulf terminals are blind spots (local logs only)

description: Managed file transfer, EDI translation and partner APIs: carrier bay plans and container status, customs release and hold status, port community systems, trading supplier and customer EDI, tenant rent files from banks
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Gate releases depend on customs hold status; carriers need load lists and completion messages within the vessel window; Freight Trading orders and advance ship notices; one hub serves all three divisions
manual_workaround: Customs data exchange web portal and carrier email for the terminals; trading orders by email and phone; tenant payments posted from bank portals
dependent_third_parties: Customs data exchange service; port community systems; carriers; banks; EDI value-added network
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: All three divisions; the P08 incident starts here

business_process: Payroll and HR, including longshore payroll
description: Time capture, payroll for 31,000 permanent staff and weekly longshore payroll, onboarding and terminations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Weekly longshore pay under the collective bargaining agreements; a missed longshore payroll risks a work stoppage at the terminals; terminations drive access removal
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior payroll; hiring halls supply hours sheets on paper
dependent_third_parties: Payroll SaaS provider; hiring halls
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Termination events feed SYS-G1; longshore hours come from the TOS and gate

business_process: Financial close, treasury and SEC reporting
description: Close, consolidation, treasury payments and SEC filings including Form 8-K
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Filing deadlines; a Form 8-K Item 1.05 filing is due 4 business days after a materiality determination
manual_workaround: Manual consolidation; outside filing agent
dependent_third_parties: ERP SaaS vendor; filing agent; banks
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Needs incident facts from the SOC and all divisions

description: Productivity suite used for carrier, trader, tenant and regulator communication
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Incident communications and partner coordination run through email and chat; Coast Guard and FBI contacts are kept out of band
manual_workaround: Out-of-band contact list on paper and personal phones; group crisis bridge line
dependent_third_parties: Productivity SaaS vendor
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Federal sales workspace (SYS-F3) is a restricted area of SYS-G6

description: Work about 55 vessel calls a week at 9 terminals: crane work queues, container and breakbulk moves, lashing, tally and completion messages to carriers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A vessel call has a fixed berth window of about 18 to 36 hours; a missed window delays the carrier service and the next port. Hazardous cargo stowage data must be current. About $9.3 million average division revenue per day
manual_workaround: Paper bay plans and load lists from carriers; work queues by radio from shift superintendents; tally on paper; workable for about one shift at reduced productivity
dependent_systems: SYS-T1; SYS-T1L; SYS-T3; SYS-G1; SYS-G2; SYS-G3
dependent_third_parties: Ocean carriers; longshore hiring halls; crane vendors
dependent_people_or_facilities: Vessel planners; superintendents; longshore labor; 9 terminals
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: SYS-G1 sign-in; WAN; carrier EDI through SYS-G4

description: About 14,000 truck gate transactions a day: TWIC check, OCR of container, chassis and plate, appointment and customs hold check, interchange receipt
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Trucks queue on port roads within about 2 hours; releasing a container on a customs hold is a regulatory failure, so the gate stops rather than guess
manual_workaround: Manual gate on reduced lanes with a printed release list; TWIC checked by security officers; paper interchange receipts
dependent_third_parties: Trucking companies; customs data exchange service; OCR vendor
dependent_people_or_facilities: Gate clerks; security officers; gate complexes
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Customs status through SYS-G4; Freight Trading truckers use the same gates

description: Container inventory and location, RTG, ASC and yard tractor dispatch through VMTs, reefer monitoring
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Without current locations containers are lost in the stacks; the T5 automated stack cannot run manually; reefers must be checked by hand every 4 hours
manual_workaround: Printed yard inventory from the last export; radio dispatch; manual reefer rounds; T5 automated stack stops and T5 vessels shift to T6 where possible
dependent_third_parties: Crane and ASC vendors
dependent_people_or_facilities: Yard clerks; equipment operators; reefer mechanics
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: WAN and provider A for SYS-T1

business_process: Facility security, access control and hazardous cargo control
description: TWIC-based access to secure areas under 9 Facility Security Plans, CCTV, patrols, and the dangerous cargo location list used by FSOs and responders
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Responders must find hazardous cargo at any time; FSP access control must continue at every MARSEC level (33 CFR Part 105); a failure could contribute to a transportation security incident
manual_workaround: Visual TWIC checks with handwritten logs; printed dangerous cargo list from each shift; CCTV records locally
dependent_third_parties: Port police and fire; Captain of the Port
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: The T3 container freight station warehouse (Port Real Estate) reports to the T3 PACS

business_process: Crane, ASC and yard equipment OT
description: Operate and maintain 64 STS cranes, 210 RTGs, 48 ASCs at T5 and about 900 yard tractors; PLC and HMI programs; the T5 equipment control system
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A crane with a corrupted PLC program cannot work; the T5 ASCs need the equipment control system. RPO is the last approved program version
manual_workaround: Cranes in local mode with operators in the cab; isolate OT zones; vendor technicians reload programs
dependent_third_parties: Crane, ASC and equipment vendors (remote diagnostics)
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: None beyond site power and the OT zone firewalls (T1 to T6); flat networks at T7 to T9

description: Release and hold status, bay plans, load and discharge lists, container status and port community system messages for all 9 terminals
process_owner: Marine Terminals director of terminal systems
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Partners can resend the last 24 hours of messages, so data loss is recoverable; an unreliable hold status stops import deliveries
manual_workaround: Customs data exchange web portal; carriers email lists
dependent_third_parties: Carriers; customs data exchange service; port community systems
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Runs entirely on the group integration hub (SYS-G4)

description: Berth schedules, stowage and crane split plans, yard allocation, and the berth and yard optimization service
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Plans are made 24 to 72 hours ahead; manual stowage of heavy or hazardous containers needs a second planner check
manual_workaround: Plan from carrier bay plans and spreadsheets; the optimization service is not needed
dependent_third_parties: Carriers; optimization service vendor
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: None

description: Terminal customer portal and truck appointment system used by carriers, cargo owners and about 4,200 trucking companies
process_owner: Marine Terminals director of customer services
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Truckers plan the next day from appointments and availability; customer commitments in terminal services agreements (P09 scope)
manual_workaround: Phone and email appointments; availability lists emailed twice a day
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider A; customer identity service
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: SYS-G3 hosting; Freight Trading truckers book through it

business_process: Gulf terminal operations on the legacy TOS (T7 to T9)
description: Vessel, yard and gate processes at the 3 Gulf terminals on SYS-T1L until migration (2027-06-30)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Same drivers as BP-MT01 and BP-MT02. Target RPO 1 hour; achievable today is 24 hours (nightly backups to local disk at each terminal)
manual_workaround: Same manual procedures as T1 to T6; carriers can divert some calls to other ports
dependent_third_parties: Legacy TOS vendor; carriers; crane vendor
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: No SIEM visibility (gap 2); flat IT and OT networks

description: Vessel and cargo handling invoices, demurrage and storage charges
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Charges can be rebuilt from TOS move history; cash impact grows after a week
manual_workaround: Queue invoices; rebuild from move history
dependent_third_parties: Payment service provider
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: SYS-G5 ERP

description: Purchase and sales contracts, positions and hedges, credit checks, invoicing for steel, lumber and construction commodities
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $37 million average division revenue per day; open positions must be known to manage price risk; trade records must not be lost
manual_workaround: Traders work from the last position report; phone and email orders recorded on paper tickets
dependent_third_parties: CTRM SaaS vendor; banks; EDI value-added network
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Supplier and customer EDI through SYS-G4; about 30% of import tonnage moves through group terminals

description: Receiving, scaling, cutting and shipping at 38 yards and service centers; shipping documents and bills of lading
process_owner: Freight Trading director of yard operations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customers' construction schedules; trucks queue at scales; overweight loads are a road safety issue
manual_workaround: Handwritten scale tickets and shipping documents; ship from the last printed pick list
dependent_third_parties: Yard system vendor; carriers
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Yard system hosted as SaaS; WAN to 38 sites

description: Purchase orders to mills and suppliers, import bookings, customs entries through licensed brokers, inbound through group and other terminals
process_owner: Freight Trading director of supply chain
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Vessel arrivals are known weeks ahead; brokers file entries on their own systems
manual_workaround: Email and phone with suppliers and brokers
dependent_third_parties: Customs brokers; ocean carriers; suppliers
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Import cargo through Marine Terminals; customer of the terminals like any other cargo owner (gap 1)

description: Quotes, orders and shipments under DoD supply contracts in the federal sales workspace (FCI scope)
process_owner: Freight Trading federal contracts compliance manager
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Contract delivery dates; FCI must stay inside the assessed scope; incident reports under DFARS 252.204-7012 run 72 hours
manual_workaround: Hold quotes; ship scheduled orders from printed documents
dependent_third_parties: DoD prime contractors and contracting officers
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: SYS-G6 and SYS-F1 restricted areas

description: Badge access, intrusion alarms and CCTV at 46 warehouses and 3 yards, run by 5 integrators
process_owner: Port Real Estate director of building technology
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Tenant cargo security and life safety; the container freight station inside the T3 secure area is covered by the T3 FSP
manual_workaround: Guards on site; doors locked in fail-secure mode; local recorders keep video
dependent_third_parties: 5 systems integrators
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: The T3 CFS readers report to the T3 PACS (Marine Terminals)

description: HVAC, lighting, dock doors and fire panel monitoring through the BMS at 46 warehouses
process_owner: Port Real Estate director of building technology
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Tenant operations at temperature-sensitive sites; fire panels alarm locally regardless of the BMS
manual_workaround: Local controller schedules; technicians on site
dependent_third_parties: 5 systems integrators
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: WAN; no SOC monitoring (gap 5)

business_process: Lease administration, rent billing and tenant portal
description: Leases for about 180 tenants, rent invoices, tenant service requests and certificates of insurance
process_owner: Port Real Estate chief financial officer
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Monthly rent cycle; tenant rent files arrive from banks through SYS-G4
manual_workaround: Invoices from the last rent roll; service requests by phone
dependent_third_parties: Property management SaaS vendor; banks
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Tenant bank files through SYS-G4

business_process: Property acquisitions, closings and wire payments
description: Purchase and sale of port-area property, construction draws and closing wires
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Closings are scheduled; the main risk is fraud, not downtime (a $2.4 million wire redirection attempt in 2026-03)
manual_workaround: Postpone closings; callback verification by phone
dependent_third_parties: Title and escrow agents; banks
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Group treasury payments (SYS-G5)

business_process: Truck staging and container depot yards
description: Gate, storage and repair of empty containers at 3 yards serving terminal truckers
process_owner: Port Real Estate director of yard operations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Empty container returns feed terminal gates; congestion spills onto port roads
manual_workaround: Manual gate with paper logs
dependent_third_parties: Carriers; trucking companies
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Container status messages to carriers through SYS-G4
